name: Fushiko Kaname
source:
Third year student, Extreme Judo Club president

She is a third year student at Toaru Girls Academy and president of the Extreme Judo Club. She is seen as a dignified and elegant girl although she is clueless around the opposite sex. She has never had a boyfriend but is curious about romantic relationships.
